title: Inspector
kind.title: Title
empty.title: Select an item
empty.storyboardText: Its takes, duration, fades and color will appear here.
empty.text: Shots, prompts, frames and audio clips are adjusted here.
elsewhere.audio: The audio clip “{name}”, selected in {space}, stays selected there.
elsewhere.title: The title “{name}”, selected in {space}, stays selected there.
elsewhere.prompt: The local instruction “{name}”, selected in {space}, stays selected there.
elsewhere.frame: The frame “{name}”, selected in {space}, stays selected there.
elsewhere.marker: The marker “{name}”, selected in {space}, stays selected there.
elsewhere.reference: The reference “{name}”, selected in {space}, stays selected there.
elsewhere.lane: The channel strip “{name}”, selected in {space}, stays selected there.
sound.hint: The sound of the video plays in the viewer and in the export, with the shot's fades. A take without a sound track stays silent.
sound.muted: This shot's sound is muted in the viewer and in the export.
sound.trackMuted: Track V1 is muted: no shot sound plays. Unmute it with M in the V1 track header.
sound.otherSolo: An audio track is soloed: the shot sound plays again when you solo V1 too or clear the solo.
frames.hint: FL2VA starts the take on the first frame and ends it on the last one.
field.sourceInHint: Start position in the source media
field.name: Name
field.subtitle: Subtitle
field.label: Label
fades.video: The picture and the shot's sound fade gradually, in the viewer as in the export. The white handles at the top of the clip also set the fades.
fades.audio: The audio level follows the fade curve. The white handles at the top of the clip also set the fades.
lane.deleteHint.one: Its {count} audio clip is deleted with it. Undo brings both back.
lane.deleteHint.other: Its {count} audio clips are deleted with it. Undo brings them back.
lane.deleteEmpty: The track holds no audio clip.
prompt.placeholder: Action, framing, movement, special lighting, dialogue…
color.pending: Color can be adjusted once the shot is generated.
color.gap: Color mismatch with the previous shot
color.appliedAll: Color settings applied to all shots
match.title: Auto match
match.driftHint: Matching shot after shot to the previous one adds up drift: a key frame or a reference holds the look better.
match.noAnchor: No anchor: add a start frame or an image reference to this shot.
match.failed: The anchor or the take could not be read.
match.stale: The take changed since the measurement: measure again, the export ignores this match.
match.exportNote: The match is baked into a 3D LUT applied on export, before the fine adjustments.
takes.empty: No take generated for this shot yet.
takes.emptyHint: Start with quick drafts, then render the best one in final quality.
takes.note: Drafts in {res} to judge the motion · Final render upscales the take or renders it again in {final} with the same seed.
lane.referenceHint: The part of this track under each shot goes with its generation, except a clip set otherwise: as a guide with MiniMax H3 in Ref2VA, mixed onto the take with the other engines.
audio.referenceOn: Set on this clip: it goes with the generation of the shots over it, whatever its track.
audio.referenceOff: Set on this clip: it never goes with a generation, whatever its track.
audio.referenceLane: Follows {lane}, a reference track: it goes with the generation of the shots over it.
audio.referenceNone: Follows {lane}, which is not a reference track: it is not sent.
audio.sliceHint: Cuts this clip into {count} slices, the last one {last} long, each with its own Reference switch.
audio.sliceTooShort: The clip is not longer than {dur}: nothing to slice.
audio.sliceTooMany: More than {max} slices: choose a longer length.
audio.joinNone: No slice of the same sound follows on from it on the track.
audio.joinHint: Join puts its {count} slices back into one clip.
audio.joinApart: Its {count} slices differ by their Reference setting or their gain: nothing to join.
audio.joinSome: Join makes {items} clips of its {count} slices: those whose Reference setting or gain differs stay apart.
audio.shotsHint: Cuts this clip at the edges of the shots over it: {count} slices, one per shot, with what lies outside the shots kept apart.
audio.shotsNone: No shot edge falls inside this clip.
audio.shotsTooMany: The shots would cut it into more than {max} slices.
lane.shotsHint.one: Cuts {count} clip of this track at the edges of the shots: {slices} slices.
lane.shotsHint.other: Cuts {count} clips of this track at the edges of the shots: {slices} slices.
lane.shotsNone: No shot edge falls inside the clips of this track.
lane.shotsTooMany: The shots would cut its clips into more than {max} slices each.
vref.nameHint: The name never changes the label: the track stays {label}, and a prompt cites it as @{label}.
vref.motionHint: Motion: each shot receives what lies under it, from its start.
vref.continuationHint: Continuation: each shot receives what comes just before it; the cut ends on the seam and the shot carries it on.
vref.lengthHint: The longest part sent to a shot, never less than {least}, and never longer than the shot.
vref.engineHint: Only MiniMax-H3 in Ref2VA receives a reference video. Other engines generate without it, and nothing is blocked.
vref.itemHint: Each shot receives the part of this video that falls in its window.
speed.label: Speed
speed.hint: Slowed to {value}%: the shot lasts longer on the timeline and the sound of its take is muted.
speed.ready: Slowed to {value}%: the {fps} fps version is ready, the export reads it.
speed.making: Slowed to {value}%: the {fps} fps version is on its way.
speed.failed: Slowed to {value}%: the {fps} fps version failed; the export repeats frames.
speed.needed: Slowed to {value}%: without its {fps} fps version, the export repeats frames.
speed.noInterpolator: Slowed to {value}%: no interpolator is ready for its {fps} fps version; the export repeats frames.
